hero.name: Ethan Chen
hero.description: With 14 years of software design, product planning and 17 years of executive and investment experience. He is a VC Partner, senior operations expert, and technical author/translator. Ethan combines technical expertise, operational practice, and investor perspective to assist talent in career review and provide practical talent organization and strategy advice for entrepreneurs.

profile.title: Multidisciplinary Professional Background
profile.subtitle: Perfect fusion of software design, product planning, scalable operations, and investment perspective
profile.p1: Ethan has 14 years of software design, product planning background and 17 years of executive and investment experience. He was an R&D manager at ASUS and SYSTEX, leading large-scale medical system developments with FDA certification. As a serial entrepreneur, he co-founded Jiepang (5 million users) and Nuandao, with extremely strong practical ability to build teams of 100 people from scratch.
profile.p2: Currently a VC Partner and independent angel investor, Ethan was selected as an annual mentor by 'Zaih' (9.6/10 rating). He excels in using a 'full-chain talent perspective'—from COO (recruiter) to VC (evaluator) to career coach (planner)—to help high-end talent break through bottlenecks and precisely search for core positions such as CTO and VP for enterprises.
profile.advantage_desc: 360-degree talent selection perspective, highly accurate prediction of core executives' competence, value matching, and long-term stability.
profile.endorsement_desc: Translated and published 6 technical books (including 'Embedded Linux System', chosen as a textbook by Tsinghua University), demonstrating extreme professional depth and logical analysis.
